roles.title: Artist Development and Strategy Consultant · Sep 2022 - Present

Advise studios, labels, and creative companies on pricing, operating model, and AI workflow adoption, a business-side line of the practice distinct from the artist work.

Sustain 90% client retention across roughly 25 relationships a year including high-profile Argentine artists, while owning P&L, pricing, and client development and leading a four-person team.
